title: Goal S3. Shared Adoption, Public Documentation and Integrated Acceptance
summary: Adopt one shared Surface presentation for Surface, Hero, Showcase and Promo while preserving semantic ownership and exact default output.
done_when: Surface, Hero, Showcase and Promo use one shared Surface presentation implementation.
Default semantic HTML remains byte-identical to the accepted entry baseline.
Public documentation describes the admitted contract without duplicate prose ownership.
Build, package, consumer and browser evidence bind one exact candidate.
